stories.headline: Advanced LLMs Write Raw Assembly for Inference Engines
stories.blurb: Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Neon demonstrated hand-writing functional x86-64 assembly to power custom AI inference engines.

stories.headline: Cognition Engineers Shift Entirely to Devin-Based Workflows
stories.blurb: Software engineers at Cognition are now developing features exclusively through automated AI agents without pulling code bases locally.

stories.headline: Hugging Face Details Multi-Agent Architecture and Training
stories.blurb: A comprehensive guide outlines techniques for building, training, and evaluating complex multi-agent frameworks like swarms and gangs.

stories.headline: InclusionAI Releases Ming-Image-0.2 for Open-Source Visual Design
stories.blurb: An upgraded open-source visual model offers enhanced image generation targeted specifically at UI/UX and graphic design workflows.

stories.headline: SAP Confirms Source Code Compromise After Cyberattack
stories.blurb: Enterprise giant SAP confirmed a security breach involving unauthorized access that reportedly exposed internal source code.

stories.headline: Binance Restores Full Withdrawals Following $6.3B Exploit Recovery
stories.blurb: Crypto exchange Binance completed a four-week recovery process to fully stabilize operations after a massive security exploit.

stories.headline: Research Demonstrates Arbitrary Linux Execution on PlayStation 5
stories.blurb: Security researcher TheOfficialFloW released a technical presentation detailing exploits that unlock the PS5 to run native Linux.

stories.headline: Open-Source Tool Automates Removal Requests from Data Brokers
stories.blurb: A new command-line tool automates the process of sending privacy opt-out requests across dozens of personal data brokers.

stories.headline: TSMC Opens 1.4nm-Class A14 Node to Initial Chip Designers
stories.blurb: TSMC finalized design kits for its A14 process node, promising up to a 14% performance uplift or 23% power reduction over N2P.

stories.headline: Shortened 47-Day TLS Certificate Lifespans Force Automation Overhauls
stories.blurb: Impending shifts to ultra-short 47-day TLS validity periods threaten fragile renewal pipelines, forcing teams to modernize certificate lifecycle automation.

stories.headline: High-Temperature Water Inlets Eliminate Data Center Chillers
stories.blurb: Advancements allowing 45°C liquid inlet temperatures are rendering traditional data center chillers obsolete while dramatically lowering power usage.

stories.headline: Bank of England Warns of Systemic Risks in AI Debt Financing
stories.blurb: Central bankers warned that massive debt-backed investments in hyperscaler AI infrastructure could create broader macroeconomic instability.
